scope: Proposition 6.4 (Linear subspaces, signed flags and idempotents) of the manuscript “Finite congruence lattices: characterization and undecidability” (preprints/Finite-Congruence-Lattices-Characterization-and-Undecidability-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 206 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d26d6cd6285de4f2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In linear type, the initial round excludes stabilizers of proper nonzero subspaces when there are no anti-actions. In the presence of anti-actions it excludes signed flags 0 < I ≤ J < V and individual proper nontrivial idempotents. These exclusions require no prior anchor and make the collineation part of every subsequent good group irreducible.
